tickets.title: Fictional export shows accented text incorrectly
tickets.body: In this invented example a CSV export shows broken accented text in a spreadsheet. Inspect the original bytes and spreadsheet import settings.

tickets.title: Fictional CSV encoding investigation
tickets.body: A prior invented case showed correct UTF-8 bytes but the spreadsheet used a different encoding.
tickets.resolution: The operator explicitly selected UTF-8 while importing the CSV. Verify the current file before reusing that fix.
